title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Service Levels: Lab Turnaround, Rush Service and Late Turnaround Credit
content:
Corbett commits, for each tier of the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan, to a standard lab turnaround and a rush turnaround counted in business days from receipt at the lab to return shipment, and sets the rush fee, the number of rush calibrations included in each plan year without the rush fee, and the service credit when the turnaround is missed.

## Service level schedule

| Tier | Standard turnaround (business days) | Rush turnaround (business days) | Rush fee (percent of the calibration price) | Rush calibrations per plan year without the rush fee | Late turnaround credit (percent of the calibration price) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 10 | 3 | 50 | 0 | 0 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 10 | 3 | 50 | 0 | 10 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 7 | 3 | 40 | 2 | 10 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 7 | 2 | 40 | 4 | 15 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 5 | 2 | 30 | 10 | 15 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 5 | 1 | 25 | 24 | 20 |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Standard turnaround**: business days from receipt at the lab to return shipment.
- **Rush turnaround**: business days for a rush calibration.
- **Rush fee**: rush fee, percent of the calibration price (at the tier's standard unit price per unit).
- **Rush calibrations without the rush fee**: rush calibrations per plan year without the rush fee.
- **Late turnaround credit**: service credit, percent of the calibration price, when Corbett misses the turnaround.

## Notes

- CalCare Pay-Per-Service and CalCare Basic Plan include 0 rush calibrations per plan year without the rush fee; the allowance rises to 2 on CalCare Standard Plan, 4 on CalCare Accredited Plan, 10 on CalCare Onsite Plan and 24 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- The late turnaround credit on CalCare Pay-Per-Service is 0 percent of the calibration price.
- The rush turnaround is 3 business days on the first three tiers, 2 on CalCare Accredited Plan and CalCare Onsite Plan, and 1 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On the CalCare Standard Plan the standard turnaround is 7 business days from receipt at the lab to return shipment, and a rush calibration has a turnaround of 3 business days.
